title: _metrics.json - modelled quantities
description: Written by src/analyse/extract_metrics.py. MODELLED QUANTITIES ONLY: this document reads no validation target, so it cannot see the 67/143 split and cannot leak a holdout value. Scoring is src/calibrate/fit.py.

run.description: Run directory name; the run identity.

scenario.description: Validated against the CITY'S OWN declared intervention.scenarios at write time (src/registry/outputs.py injects the enum from city.json; issue #62 A1) - the portable schema file itself names no city's vocabulary.

day.description: Validated against the CITY'S OWN declared day_types at write time (src/registry/outputs.py injects the enum from city.json; issue #62 A1) - the portable schema file itself names no city's vocabulary.

fraction.description: Sample fraction. Every extensive quantity below is scaled by it.

mode_share.description: Linked main-mode share. The calibration target is ONE LGA and the model covers several, so the LGA-of-residence split is not optional - see DECISIONS.md 12.1.

target_lga_pct.description: Percent by MATSim mode, summing to 100.

pt.description: Boardings by line, scaled to full population by 1/fraction.

intervention_boardings.description: Boardings attributed to the city's declared intervention mode (city.json intervention.mode, matched against each boarded route's own scheduled transportMode). RENAMED from `light_rail_boardings` (issue #62 A1): one city's intervention was hard-named in the portable contract. BREAKING: a _metrics.json written before the rename fails this schema and cannot be scored by src/calibrate/fit.py - the same accepted class of break as newcastle_lga_pct -> target_lga_pct. Historical run artefacts are not rewritten; re-run extract_metrics.py to re-derive.

lr_share_of_pt_legs.description: Hypothesis A1's metric: light rail person-legs over TOTAL PT person-legs across the whole study area. This is NOT the observed 20.8% figure, which is light rail over (light rail + NISC 1 bus) TAPS and is an UPPER BOUND on A1. Never calibrate A1 against 20.8%.

corrections.description: The comparison-time corrections, carried WITH the metrics so a fit can never be reported without them. They apply to the comparison, not to the model.
